Completed assignments for MUSA 5080, with findings, visualizations, and

## [Assignment 5: House Price Prediction in Chicago](<Group Jollof/assignment5.html>)

Use property characteristics and spatial features to predict Chicago house
sale prices, compare models with cross-validation, and examine residual
patterns and valuation errors.

## [Assignment 4: Predicting Car-Free Households in Philadelphia](Assignment4.qmd)

Build spatial features and test how each one changes the cross-validated
error of a model predicting car-free households across Philadelphia tracts.

## [Assignment 3: Measuring Poverty in Philadelphia](Assignment3.qmd)

How did poverty change across Philadelphia? Compare poverty estimates for
2006–2010 and 2013–2017, with margins of error and a graph showing which
tract-level changes are statistically significant.

## [Assignment 2: Who Do We Know the Least About?](assignment2.qmd)

Explore uncertainty in American Community Survey estimates and what margins
of error reveal about the reliability of the data.
